sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Vikas Singh,Rajeev Upadhyay Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
Heard Sri Rajeev Upadhyay, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Varun Kumar Agnihotri,
learned AGA for the State-respondent.
The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 523 of 2022, under Sections 420, 406, 467, 468, 471, 34 IPC, Police Station- Sector 63 Noida, District- Gautam Budha Nagar, during pendency of the trial in the court below.

FIR of the present case was lodged against the applicant and her husband Vishal and Tarshen Singh and according to the FIR applicant along with her husband induced the informant that they will provide him visa of Guatemala Country and they will also provide job to him and his family members and in this regard they demanded Rs. 5 lacs each and it is further that in the FIR that on 5.12.2022 Rs. 10 lacs cash was received by the co-accused Vishal and Rs. 9,50,000 was transferred in the account of co-accused Tarshen Singh and thereafter informant provided 10 passport to them but thereafter neither any passport was provided to the informant nor the money was returned to him.

Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is the wife of co-accused Vishal and only Pranjali Sachan vs State Of U.P. on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/3598702/

sentences.text: due to this reason she has falsely been implicated in the present matter by the informant and even from the perusal of the FIR it appears that there is no allegation against the applicant that either she received any money or any money was transferred in her account and it is specifically stated in the FIR that Rs. 10 lacs cash was given to her husband Vishal and Rs. 9,50,000 was transferred in the account of co-accused Tarshen Singh and applicant is a lady and she is not having any criminal history and she is in jail since 12.12.2022.

Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the fact that there is no allegation against the applicant that she received any money from the informant and money was transferred in the account of co-accused Tarshen Singh and Rs. 10 lacs cash alleged to have been received by the husband of the applicant.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

From the perusal of the record, it appears that co-accused Vishal received Rs. 10 lacs cash from the informant and Rs. 9,50,000 was transferred in the account of co-accused Tarshen Singh and there is no allegation against the applicant that she received any money from the informant and it appears that merely being wife of the co-accused Vishal, she has been made accused in the present matter.
She is a lady and is not having any previous criminal history and in the present matter she is in jail since 12.12.2022.
Therefore, from the discussion made above, in my view applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.
Let the applicant- Pranjali Sachan be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.
Order Date :- 23.3.2023 KK Patel  Pranjali Sachan vs State Of U.P. on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/3598702/
